meta.name: entity-optimizer
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "optimize entity presence"; builds Knowledge Graph, Wikidata, sameAs, and AI recognition signals for a canonical entity identity. Not for page-level AI-citation readiness — use geo-content-optimizer. 实体优化/知识图谱

copy.tagline: 优化实体在知识图谱中的表现
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要提升品牌或实体在搜索引擎和AI中的识别度
copy.tagline_en: Optimize entity presence in knowledge graphs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to improve brand or entity recognition in search engines and AI

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会审计你的品牌、人物或产品在知识图谱、维基数据、维基百科和AI系统中的识别情况，生成一份包含6类47项信号的差距分析报告，并给出优化方案。
howto.when: 当你要求“优化实体识别”或“审计实体存在”时触发。

say.text: 审计 Acme Analytics 的实体识别情况。
say.note: Claude 会检查该品牌在知识图谱和AI系统中的表现。

say.text: 帮我建立新品牌“绿野科技”的实体身份。
say.note: Claude 会生成实体档案并列出优先行动。

say.text: 我的知识面板信息有误，请修复。
say.note: Claude 会分析信号差距并给出修正步骤。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude audits how well your brand, person, or product is recognized in Knowledge Graph, Wikidata, Wikipedia, and AI systems. It produces a gap analysis across 6 signal categories (47 signals) and a building plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'optimize entity presence' or 'audit entity presence'.

say_en.text: Audit entity presence for Acme Analytics.
say_en.note: Claude checks Knowledge Graph and AI recognition.

say_en.text: Build entity presence for new brand 'GreenTech'.
say_en.note: Claude creates a canonical profile and priority actions.

say_en.text: Fix incorrect info in my Knowledge Panel.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes signal gaps and suggests fixes.
